pages.text: $(item)A Dark Presence calls out to you from the void.$()$(br2)I haven't heard from $(primary)Atlas$() or the $(primary)Command Center$() in a while. This might be worth investigating?$(br2)$(italic)A few day passes...$()$(br2)After researching the properties of $(item)Radiant Stars$(), you came up with a hypothesis. Attuning an $(item)Infused Radiant Star$() to the blood god will create a $(item)Star of the Blood Moon$().

Before you can test your hypothesis, you must synthesize a $(item)Infused Radiant Star$(). You believe you need something like the fluid transposer machine, but much more advanced.$(br2)You ponder for days, then finally come up with a design that could work. You have created the schematics for the $(item)Enderium Infusion Basin$() multiblock machine.$(br2)For a material list, check $(l:portal_hub/4_schematica)Schematica$()

Your theory is that the $(item)Star of the Blood Moon$() could open up rifts to other realities.$(br2)$(primary)Atlas$() never mentioned such a thing as multiple realities. But the pull you feel is telling you otherwise.$(br2)The pull is coming from those odd shrines in the $(item)Combat Simulation$() that are surrounded by vibrant mushrooms.$(br2)$(italic)You feel so close to getting it..$()
Since you have been given no new goal from the command center, you might as well test your crazy theory.
